name: @platfolio/site
description: platfolio's own web shell (D65): an Astro site that renders packages/ui, with the dashboard as one React island. There is deliberately NO workspace edge on @platfolio/ui — it is reached through the alias in astro.config.mjs and the paths in tsconfig.json. See the $comment in tsconfig.json for the open question that decision is standing in for.
